official_definition: Twinkle Bombardment - (Timing) If you control any During Advent Spirit, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. For each "Emperor Beast" family Spirit card among them, send an opposing Life to their Reserve. Add the revealed cards to the Hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Bombardment] or [Twinkle Bombardment: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Bombardment]", "give [Twinkle Bombardment]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
